summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing daily open-market share repurchases under a program announced 6 Jan 2026. Between 26-29 May 2026, it bought 2.504m shares on XLON at prices ranging GBP 10.73–11.43 per share (volume-weighted averages GBP 10.79–11.33). Shares were bought from JPM Securities and will be cancelled, reducing the ordinary share count to ~2.519bn. The program is authorized by the 2025 AGM and conducted under UK Listing Rules and Hong Kong Code. Since program start, 34.91m shares were repurchased at a VWAP of 1,121.36p. Watch for continued buyback pace as a signal of capital return commitment.
